preprocessing.pooling: 2x2 maximum ink; isotropic factor2, no interpolation
preprocessing.normalization: one global mean/std from training pixels only
preprocessing.calibration: per-lead calibration pulses retained in pixels; no numeric metadata feature
preprocessing.limitation: downsampling thickens narrow strokes and merges fine detail; variable page gain retained; not lossless waveform reconstruction

loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits; five independent binary targets
selection_rule: Strict lexicographic maximum of validation (macro_roc_auc, macro_average_precision, -probability_binary_cross_entropy); earliest epoch on exact tie
threshold_policy: fixed sigmoid probability >=0.5; no threshold search
search_budget: One prespecified compact CNN-feature hybrid ViT configuration, seed42, max20epochs,patience4; synthetic-only resource checks; no architecture search on ECG outcomes
test_policy: One final model inference after freezing and train-only replay; fold10 has already been observed for CNNLSTM and TCN, so comparative results are exploratory; no test tuning
sequence_interpretation: 70 left-to-right spatial image-feature tokens across aligned leads, including calibration; hybrid CNN feature-patch Transformer with learned positions and global attention; not recovered waveform samples, vanilla raw-patch ViT, or a causal streaming model
comparison_limit: Exploratory same-cohort comparison to saved CNNLSTM and TCN; same inputs/folds/threshold/optimizer/budget, one configuration/seed each. Architecture/head capacity and dropout topology differ; no external or seed robustness established. No Mendeley accuracy ranking.

uncertainty.method: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of final test predictions
uncertainty.scope: test-sampling uncertainty conditional on this fitted model; excludes seed/training/external-domain variation

architecture.spatial_encoder: Same depthwise/pointwise 2D CNN as PTBXL CNNLSTM/TCN, independently trained from scratch

paired_comparison.differences: Hybrid ViT minus TCN (primary) and minus CNNLSTM (secondary), identical saved test records
paired_comparison.cluster: patient, same draw for both models
paired_comparison.limitation: conditional exploratory sampling intervals, exclude training seed/model-selection/external-domain uncertainty
